messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

All searches are in. Local/CON29 clear (offices, Use Class E, no enforcement, no road or CPO proposals), drainage connected (shared SW connection to no.12 per the 1999 easement), environmental passed/low risk, chancel clear. Nothing that affects value. I'll fold these into the report on title.

The only real income risk is the Northbank break on 29 Sep 2025 (1st floor, £198,500 p.a.). I'll flag it prominently for the client.

Elena

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
